chunks: And with this chain of narration, it was said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Whoever says, when he enters the marketplace: 'Glory be to God, Praise be to God, and there is no god but God, He is One, there is no partner for Him, to Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs the praise, He gives life and causes death, and He is Living and does not die, all good is in His Hand, and He has power over all things,' will be given a reward equal to the number of all things God has created until the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.بِيَدِهِ الخَيْر: All good is in His Hand
key_terms.لا إِلهَ إِلاّ اللَّهُ: There is no god but God
key_terms.يُحْيِي وَيُميتُ: He gives life and causes death

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication for entering the market in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this tradition links the commercial sphere to spiritual purification through a comprehensive dhikr affirming God’s absolute sovereignty and creative power. The promise of reward equal to 'all created things' underscores the transformative potential of mindful remembrance in daily economic activities, a key theme in Shia ethical jurisprudence.
